description: App shell layout - Fixed 46px header, 232px collapsible sidebar with independent scroll, main content area with independent scroll, and page-frame centered container. Implements the exact layout architecture from design.md Section 4-6 including sidebar collapse, breadcrumbs, live clock, notification panel, theme toggle, help center access, and sidebar utility links fixed at bottom.
steps: Create src/components/layout/app-header.tsx: 46px fixed header with CSS grid (3 columns as per design.md). Left: sidebar collapse button + single breadcrumb. Center: search input (command palette trigger). Right: notification button with dot, live clock (HH:mm:ss), help center button, theme toggle (icon button), user avatar/menu. Use the icon-button pattern (30px square) from design.md

Create src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx: 232px width (64px collapsed), grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto. Brand area at top (LDO-2 EDMS branding with orange accent). Scrollable nav section in middle with nav items (30px height, 12px text, icon + label). Fixed utility section at bottom (Settings, Help Center, Search). Active item uses --primary background. Sections labeled with tiny muted uppercase text. Collapse state hides labels, shows icons only with tooltips

Create src/components/layout/notification-panel.tsx: Dropdown panel (360px wide) from notification button. Shows grouped notifications (Needs action, FYI, System). Each item: title, context, timestamp, action button. Action buttons navigate to relevant pages. Mark read, snooze, dismiss secondary actions. Empty state when no notifications
Create src/components/layout/live-clock.tsx: Compact clock component using useEffect + setInterval. Displays HH:mm:ss in mono font, muted color. Timezone in tooltip

Create src/components/layout/breadcrumb-nav.tsx: Simple breadcrumb showing current location. Single level for simple pages, parent/current for nested. Slash separator, 12-13px, muted parent + strong current
Create src/components/layout/page-frame.tsx: Centered content wrapper - width: min(100% - 32px, 1480px), margin: 18px auto 32px. Variants: sm (960px), md (1180px), lg (1480px), xl (1680px)

Create src/app/(protected)/layout.tsx: Protected route group layout. Uses CSS grid: full height, grid-template-rows 46px 1fr for header + body. Body grid: sidebar-width 1fr. Applies independent overflow:auto on main-scroll and sidebar-scroll. Wraps content in the shell structure from design.md Section 4
Create src/stores/sidebar-store.ts: Zustand store for sidebar state (collapsed: boolean, toggle function). Persists to localStorage
Create src/stores/notification-store.ts: Zustand store for notifications (items array, unreadCount, markRead, dismiss functions). Initially populated with mock notifications
Update src/app/layout.tsx to only contain the root providers (ThemeProvider, QueryProvider). The shell layout is in the (protected) group
Create src/app/(protected)/page.tsx as a placeholder dashboard page that uses PageFrame and shows 'Dashboard' text (will be built out in FEAT-005)
Create src/app/login/page.tsx as a simple login page placeholder (will be built out in FEAT-004)
Verify: 'npm run build' succeeds, 'npm run lint' passes, dev server shows the shell layout correctly
acceptance_criteria: Header is exactly 46px height with 3-column grid layout
Sidebar is 232px expanded, 64px collapsed, with independent scroll on nav links
Sidebar utility links (Settings, Help Center, Search) are fixed at bottom and do not scroll
Collapse button is in the header (not the sidebar)
Main content area has independent scroll from sidebar
Live clock shows HH:mm:ss in header right section
Theme toggle switches between light and dark modes
Notification panel opens as dropdown with actionable items
Page frame centers content with proper max-width and top margin
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit 0
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
